column2:
[title18][sentence]
Apparently, some small animal wandered into
the anti-grav beam when you turned it on.  When the
timer ran out and the beam turned off the poor thing
came down hard.  Hey look!  A six-chambered heart!
Neat!
column3:
[title18][sentence]
反重力光束打開時，顯然有隻小動物
誤闖了進去。計時器歸零、
光束關閉的瞬間，那可憐傢伙
重重摔了下來。你看！
六腔的心臟耶！酷斃了！

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The bushes are thick and impassable.  They seem
to be the predominant form of vegetation on this
part of the planet.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
灌木叢又密又擋路，完全過不去。
看來這一帶最常見的
植被就是它們了。

column2:
[title17][sentence]
Wow!  Now THIS is a neat ship!  It's got a warp coil,
quad laser cannons, Kleiner defense screens, and
a conventional thruster pack that really packs a
wallop.  This ship is in good shape.
column3:
[title17][sentence]
哇！這才叫像樣的太空船！配了
躍遷線圈、四管雷射砲、
克萊納防護罩，還有一組
威力十足的傳統推進器。
船況保養得很不錯。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
That may have once been some kind
of air traffic control tower.  It is
difficult to determine the original
layout of the space port since the
native vegetation has covered most
of it.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這裡可能曾經是某種
航管塔台。由於原生植被
幾乎蓋滿了整座太空港，
很難判斷原本的格局。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
The trees here closely resemble the trees you
saw on the island near your crash site.  Perhaps
you aren't too far from there.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
這裡的樹和你墜機地點附近
島上看到的樹很像。
或許你離那裡不遠。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThe sky is blue and cloudless.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n天空一片湛藍，萬里無雲。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
Well, it won't fit in your pocket.  Why
don't you try sitting in the cockpit?
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這東西可塞不進你口袋。
要不試著坐進駕駛艙？

column2:
[title24][sentence]
This is be the area of the wall that
the laser beam is aimed at.  Apparently,
it is made of something extremely durable.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這是雷射光束瞄準的
那面牆。看樣子材質
異常堅固耐用。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
It appears someone has left a small doll
here on the pedestal.  Perhaps they
thought it was just too cute?  You
suppress an urge to set the doll alight.
You've always hated these things.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
看來有人把一個小娃娃
留在基座上。大概是覺得
太可愛捨不得丟？你按捺住
想放火燒了它的衝動——
你一向討厭這種東西。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You wouldn't be caught dead with one
of these.  You have always hated these
poorly-made commercialized pieces of
junk.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你死也不會被人看到
拿著這種東西。你向來
討厭這種粗製濫造的
商業垃圾。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
You surmise that whoever built the laboratory
also put the pedestal here with the intention
of placing test objects on it.  The laser
appears to be aimed a few inches above
the top of the pedestal.  At the moment,
that would put the beam just about
where that dolls left eye is.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你猜蓋這間實驗室的人，
特地在這裡擺了基座，
就是為了放測試物。
雷射瞄準的位置，似乎在
基座頂端上方幾吋處——
現在這個高度，剛好對準
那個娃娃的左眼。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The pedestal sits quietly beneath the
powerful laser beam.  There are a couple
scraps of doll stuffing on it.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
基座靜靜立在強力雷射
光束之下，上面還留著
幾撮娃娃填充棉絮。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The pedestal is now adorned by the
skillfully placed mirror, which is
directing the laser through the ceiling.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
基座上現在擺著一面
精準放置的鏡子，正把
雷射光導向天花板。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The sand bags are intended to protect
the person standing at the console from
flying debris.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這些沙包是用來保護
站在控制台前的人，
免得被飛濺的碎片打到。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThey are a little too heavy for you\nto be lugging around.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這東西對你來說\n重得扛不動。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
The control station is a small pedestal
with a keyboard and a monitor on it.
Instead of standard characters the keyboard
is covered with odd-looking symbols.  You
don't understand any of it.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
控制站是個小基座，上面
有鍵盤和螢幕。鍵盤上
沒有標準字母，滿滿都是
怪里怪氣的符號，你一個
字都看不懂。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe monitor is blank.  It's\nobviously off.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n螢幕一片空白，\n顯然是關著的。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
According to this monitor, the laser
is producing about a terrawatt of
optical energy.  The continuous updates
on the monitor show extreme temperature variation.
This is one serious laser cannon!
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這螢幕顯示，雷射目前
輸出大約一兆瓦的光能。
螢幕上的數值不斷跳動，
溫度變化劇烈——
這絕對是門正經的雷射砲！

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This is a BIG laser cannon.  From
all the hoses you assume it's liquid-cooled and
connected directly to the city's power grid.
This is one beast you wouldn't want to
get in the way of.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這是一門超巨大雷射砲。
看那堆管線，你猜是液冷式，
還直接接上整座城市的
電網。這頭猛獸，你絕對
不會想擋在它前面。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The large laser cannon is emitting a constant
beam of light.  A low humming noise can
be heard from the cooling system within the
enormous device.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
這門大雷射砲正持續
發射光束。從這龐然大物
內部的冷卻系統，傳來
低沉的嗡嗡聲。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
If only you could!  Wouldn't this
be just the thing to quick-draw on
some alien slimeball?  Of course, it would
probably be difficult to quick-draw
something bigger than your bedroom.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你也很想啊！拿這玩意
對某個外星爛貨來場
快速拔槍對決，豈不痛快？
只不過，要拔出一個比你
臥室還大的傢伙，大概
沒那麼容易。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThis little lever is unmarked.  It is unclear\nwhat its function is.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n這根小拉桿上沒有標示，\n看不出是做什麼用的。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This is the lever you used to
turn on the laser canon.  It appears
to be locked in its current position.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這就是你用來啟動
雷射砲的拉桿。目前
似乎卡死在這個位置。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The lever is about as 'pushed' as it
is going to get.  If you would like to
move it toward you, you should
consider pulling it.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這根拉桿已經『推』到底了，
不能再推。如果想把它
往自己這邊移，你該試試
『拉』。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nIt looks like a good thing to avoid.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n看起來還是離遠一點\n比較好。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The laser beam has been deflected
up through the ceiling and into whatever
is above this lab.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
雷射光束被反射向上，
穿過天花板，射進了
這間實驗室樓上的某處。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Oh sure.  Just reach up and grab it, right?
You shake your head a bit, and as your
brain settles back into its cradle the last
few critical neural connections are made.
You decide not to try to grab the beam.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
喔，對啦，伸手抓住就好了，
是吧？你搖搖頭，腦袋
晃了一晃歸位，最後幾條
神經總算接對線。你決定
還是別去抓那道光束。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The ceiling is sporting a few scorch marks
that you assume are the result of beam
deflections.  It is otherwise uninteresting.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
天花板上有幾道焦痕，
你猜是光束反射造成的。
除此之外沒什麼好看的。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The reflected laser beam has carved
a large hole in the ceiling and is now
firing straight through it.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
反射的雷射光束在天花板
上鑿出一個大洞，現在
正直直穿過那個洞發射。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The wall is marred by several scorch marks.
These must have occurred when something
semi-reflective was hit with the laser.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
牆上有幾道焦黑痕跡，
應該是某個半反光物體
被雷射打中留下的。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Wow!  You have ALWAYS wanted to
shred one of those stupid dolls.  That
felt really good!  Of course, the laser
was built for continuous fire operation
and is still on.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
哇！你一直很想
把那些蠢娃娃碎屍萬段，
這下真是爽快！不過，
這雷射砲是設計來連續
發射的，現在還開著。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You skillfully place the [noun1] on the pedestal
in the path of the laser.  You manage to reflect
it straight up, where it burns its way through
the ceiling.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你熟練地把[noun1]放上
基座，擋在雷射路徑上。
光束被你反射得筆直向上，
燒穿了天花板。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
There is no room on the pedestal for
the [noun1].  Perhaps you should
'remove' the doll first.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
基座上沒有空間
放[noun1]了。或許你該
先把娃娃『移開』。

column2: [title30][sentence]\nThe laser beam has already been\nreflected in the other mirror.
column3: [title30][sentence]\n雷射光束已經被\n另一面鏡子反射走了。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou tug on the lever, but it seems to\nbe jammed in the "ON" position.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你用力拉拉桿，但它似乎\n卡死在「開」的位置。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You wouldn't seriously consider
eating at an 'X-creetza Hut' franchise
would you?  Think about it.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你該不會真的想去
『痢勝客』吃飯吧？
你自己想想看。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
According to the readouts in the car,
this must be the Barnett motel.  You
of course have better things to do just
now than sleep, so your interest in
the motel is short-lived.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
根據車上的顯示，這裡
應該是巴奈特汽車旅館。
你當然還有更重要的事
要忙，沒空睡覺，對這家
旅館也就意思一下，
很快就沒了興趣。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe sign reads: 'Sid's Cycle Shop'.  There\nis an old air bike parked in front of it.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
招牌寫著：『席德機車行』。
門口停著一輛老舊的
飛行機車。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Wow! An honest-to-goodness air bike!
You haven't seen one of these babies
since you were a kid.  To bad the thing
is old and rusted; you would love to
take this beast for a ride.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
哇！貨真價實的飛行機車！
你從小到大都沒再見過
這種寶貝了。可惜這台
又老又鏽，不然你真想
騎上去兜兜風。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This old thing is so rusty it would
probably fall apart the second you put
the kick stand up.  You had better
leave it alone.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這老骨董鏽成這樣，
你腳架一收大概就
當場散架。還是
別碰的好。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The software store has a large monitor
on its roof.  There is a sensor over the
door, leading you to believe that it is an
automated entrance.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
軟體商店的屋頂上有個
大螢幕。門上方裝著感應器，
看來是自動門。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
Judging by the shape of the building 
you conclude that it must be some 
kind of research laboratory.  The large
microscope on it's roof serves as
a subtle hint.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
從建築外型判斷，
你猜這裡應該是某種
研究實驗室——屋頂上
那台大顯微鏡，
算是個不算隱晦的提示。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The street goes on for quite a distance.
You decide that it would be better if
you stayed with the car.  If you got
lost in the middle of the city you
could spend days finding your way back.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
這條街延伸得相當遠。
你決定還是待在車子
附近比較好——萬一在
市中心迷路，搞不好
要花好幾天才找得回來。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You glance around and notice a restaurant, 
a motel, a laboratory, a software store and various
other buildings.  The inner walls of the
cylindrical city tower over your head.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你環顧四周，看到一家餐廳、汽車旅館、
實驗室、軟體店等各種建築。
圓筒形城市的內牆，高聳在你頭頂上方。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The software store sign looks like a
large monitor.   You suspect, in your sly and
clever way, that it is not a REAL monitor,
but is in fact a facade!  HA!  Nobody can
pull anything over on Rex Nebular!
column3:
[title32][sentence]
軟體店的招牌看起來
像個大螢幕。憑你狡猾
又聰明的直覺，你懷疑那
根本不是真螢幕，而是個
假的外殼！哈！休想在
雷克斯‧尼布勒面前耍花招！

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThis is the cute little MLV car you\narrived in.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n這就是你搭來的\n那台可愛小磁浮車。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
You spend a moment gazing at the sky.
You spend another moment gazing at the sky.
You spend yet another moment gazing at the sky.
You spend an eternity gazing empty-headedly at the sky.
You spend a half a second recovering your senses.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你盯著天空看了一會兒。
你又盯著天空看了一會兒。
你再次盯著天空看了一會兒。
你放空盯著天空看了一輩子。
你花半秒鐘回過神來。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This appears to be ground transport,
able to negotiate all variety of terrain.
If only you knew how to drive one.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這看起來是種地面載具，
能應付各種地形。
可惜你根本不會開。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
Boy! Are you ever ambitious!
Do you know what a double hernia is?
Try taking things that weigh less than you do.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
哇塞！你也太有野心了！
你知道『雙重疝氣』是
什麼滋味嗎？挑點
比你體重輕的東西拿吧。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
Look at the size of that missile!  It's
so long and hard.  Wait a second!
That kind of stuff has never stimulated
you before.  You'd better hope that the Gender
Bender machine is still working.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
看看那枚飛彈的尺寸！
又長又硬。等等！
這種東西以前從沒讓你
心癢過。你最好祈禱
錯體機還能正常運作。

column2: [title13][sentence]\nYou have no need for a 'peace-keeper'.
column3: [title13][sentence]\n你用不著\n這個『維和者』。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
They sure don't make grenades like they
used to.  It looks like this one has been
injected with plant fertilizer.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
現在的手榴彈真是今非昔比。
這顆看起來被灌了
植物肥料。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
You couldn't possibly carry that huge
thing around.  You certainly wouldn't
be able to throw it at anyone.  What
would you do, pull the pin and run?
column3:
[title20][sentence]
你不可能扛得動
這麼大一顆。更別說
丟得動了。難道你要
拔掉插銷然後拔腿狂奔？

column2:
[title21][sentence]
You quickly consider pulling the pin
on the huge grenade.  You imagine how
long it would take you to get out of
this complex before the arsenal blew
the whole place into the stratosphere.
You decide to continue breathing for
a few more years.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
你很快考慮了一下，
要不要拔掉這顆巨型
手榴彈的插銷。你想像著
要花多久才能在整座
軍械庫把這裡炸上
平流層之前逃出去。
你決定還是多活
幾年比較實在。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The blimp reminds you of someone you
woke up next to one morning.  You wince
at the memory and once again vow never to
drink an 'Antarian Kidney Twister' on an
empty stomach.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這艘飛船讓你想起某天
早上醒來，身邊躺著的
那個人。你想到就一陣
反胃，再次發誓絕不
空腹喝『安塔利安
腎臟扭轉』。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Talk about delusions of grandeur.
Consider taking something that's not
five thousand times your volume.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
講到自我膨脹也該有個限度。
考慮拿點體積不到你
五千倍的東西吧。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The place is full of ammunition.
Perhaps you should be careful of where
you step.  After all, one wrong move and
it's 'KABOOM' time.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這地方到處都是彈藥。
或許你該小心自己
踩的地方。畢竟一步
踩錯，就是『轟隆』
的時候了。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
You have no firearm capable of
chambering ammunition of this
caliber.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n你手上沒有槍能\n上這種口徑的彈藥。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This useful contraption has probably been
used over the years to toss such things as
anvils, one-ton tomatoes, missiles, and
shipwrecked alien visitors.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這台好用的機關，這些年
大概拿來拋射過鐵砧、
一噸重番茄、飛彈，
還有翻船的外星訪客。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
Now that's going a bit far.  How would you
get it out of here?  Can you picture yourself
discreetly wheeling a catapult around an
underground complex?  Forget it.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
這下有點過分了。你要
怎麼把它弄出去？你能
想像自己低調地推著一台
投石機，在地底基地裡
到處逛嗎？算了吧。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
In the chest you see a variety
of useless items, and a shiny
device which you immediately
recognize as a target module.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
箱子裡有各種沒用
的東西，還有一個閃亮
的裝置——你一眼
就認出是瞄準模組。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
This is the chest you found the
target module in.  It still contains
no other interesting items.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這就是你找到瞄準模組
的那個箱子。裡面
沒有其他有趣的東西了。

column2: [title12][sentence]\nAt the moment, you already have one.
column3: [title12][sentence]\n你現在手上\n已經有一個了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You wonder what good such a thin
layer of metal would be against
a laser blast.  It must be some kind
of exercise equipment.  You imagine
that donning that thing and running
around in little circles would be a terrific
workout.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你懷疑這麼薄一層金屬
能擋得住雷射轟擊嗎？
這大概是某種運動器材。
你想像穿上這玩意，
繞著小圈子跑步，
應該是很棒的運動。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
Do you know how long you would last
walking around in that thing?  In the
first five minutes you would sweat
enough to rust all the moving parts.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
你知道穿著那玩意走路
能撐多久嗎？前五分鐘
你流的汗，大概就能把
所有活動零件鏽光。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis must be a means of egress from\nthe armored vehicle.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這應該是裝甲車的\n出入口。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Try as you might you just can't get it
open.  That's O.K. though.  You didn't really
want to crawl around in an old armored
vehicle.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你怎麼弄都打不開。
不過也無所謂，你本來
也不太想爬進一台老舊
裝甲車裡到處鑽。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
These barrels look like they should contain
gunpowder or something similar.  Instead,
they seem to be full of plastic monkeys.
You wonder what possible military purpose
these monkeys could serve.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
這些桶子看起來應該裝著
火藥之類的東西。結果，
裡面裝的似乎全是
塑膠猴子。你很納悶，
這些猴子到底有什麼
軍事用途。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nYou have no need for barrels--or\nplastic monkeys for that matter.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n你用不著這些桶子——\n塑膠猴子也一樣。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe raft does not appear to be in good\nshape.  You doubt if it's even seaworthy.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這艘救生筏看起來
狀況不太好。你懷疑
它到底能不能下水。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nYou have no need for an old,\nbeat-up, unreliable, inflatable raft.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n你用不著這艘又舊\n又破、靠不住的充氣筏。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
It looks a bit like a tomato, but it's
actually much heavier.  Looking at
the numeral stenciled on the front you
determine that this must be a one-ton
tomato (as opposed to, say, a five-ton
tomato).
column3:
[title22][sentence]
看起來有點像番茄，
但重得多。看正面
噴漆印的數字，你判斷
這是一噸重的番茄
（而不是，比如說，
五噸重的番茄）。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nTry as you might you just can't lift\nthe thing.  It must really weigh a ton.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你怎麼使勁都舉不起來。
這玩意大概真的
重達一噸。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
The anvil has numerous scratches and dents
in it.  It has probably been used to catch
road runners in Monument Valley.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這個鐵砧上滿是刮痕
與凹痕。大概是在
紀念碑谷用來砸
嗶嗶鳥的道具。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You stare intently at the two-ton weight
for a moment.  The military applications
for a two-ton weight escape you so you
decide to stare at something else.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你盯著這顆兩噸重的
砝碼看了一會兒。實在
想不出兩噸重砝碼有什麼
軍事用途，你決定
去看點別的。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Baby powder?  This was definitely an
armory stocked by the female side of the
Great Gender War.  You briefly
entertain a chauvinistic thought, but are
quickly humbled by the simple fact that
they DID win the war.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
痱子粉？這座軍械庫
顯然是性別大戰時
女性陣營囤的貨。你腦中
閃過一絲大男人主義的
念頭，但一想到
她們可是打贏了那場戰爭，
立刻就矮了一截。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThis is obviously the means of bulk\napplication for the baby powder.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這顯然是用來
大量施灑痱子粉
的工具。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nYeah.   Right.  Like you've always\nwanted one of these.
column3:
[title17][sentence]
是喔，對啦，
你才不會想要
這種東西。

column2: [title11][sentence]\nThe carton sits beneath the\nanvil.
column3: [title11][sentence]\n紙箱就放在\n鐵砧下面。

column2: [title12][sentence]\nThe carton is a bit big to tote around.
column3: [title12][sentence]\n這箱子有點大，\n扛著到處走不方便。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nYou can't open the carton because\nyou can't move the anvil.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n你打不開這箱子，\n因為你搬不動鐵砧。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nTo the south is the corridor from\nwhich you entered the armory.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n南邊是你進入\n軍械庫時走的通道。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This is definitely an armory of some sort.
There is enough military hardware here to
equip a division.  The fine layer of dust that
covers everything here leads you to believe that
no one has used any of this stuff for quite
some time.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這裡顯然是某種軍械庫。
這些軍火足夠武裝
一整個師。到處覆蓋著
一層細灰，讓你猜這些
東西已經好一陣子
沒人用過了。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This appears to be a standard 47-prong
targeting module--the type that improves
a heavy weapon's firing accuracy.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這看起來是標準的
47爪瞄準模組——用來
提升重型武器射擊
精準度的那種。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nYou slip the target module into your\npocket.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n你把瞄準模組\n塞進口袋裡。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
They must use this for loading the
blimp.  It is currently blocked by
a large armored vehicle.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這裡應該是用來裝載
飛船的。目前被一輛
大型裝甲車擋住了。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nIt's already open.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n這東西已經\n開著了。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The platform stands beneath a strange
looking device.  A small ramp leads up
to the center of the platform.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這座平台位在一個外形
古怪的裝置下方。一道
小斜坡通往平台中央。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The nature of this device is not known
to you.  It doesn't look like anything
you have ever seen before.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你看不出這個裝置
是做什麼用的。這東西
跟你以前看過的
完全不一樣。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nConsidering what this thing did to you,\nit must be the infamous Gender Bender.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
想到這東西曾對你
做過什麼，這一定就是
那台惡名昭彰的錯體機。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You have no idea how to operate
these controls and decide not to
make a fool of yourself by trying to do so.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你完全不知道這些
控制器怎麼操作，
決定別亂按出糗。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This equipment is beyond your understanding,
which places it on a par with can openers and
light bulbs.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這台設備超出你的
理解範圍，跟開罐器
還有電燈泡屬於
同一個檔次。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou are momentarily mesmerized\nby the strange lights on the panel.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n面板上那些詭異的燈光\n讓你一時看得出神。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The monitor here shows an odd view
of the device in the center of the room.
Try as you might you cannot find the
camera that is producing the image.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這裡的螢幕顯示著
房間中央那台裝置的
詭異畫面。你怎麼找
都找不到拍出這畫面
的攝影機。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThe ramp appears to be the preferred\nway to the platform.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這道斜坡看起來
是通往平台的
主要路線。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
You broke the latch on the air vent
when you kicked it in.  It should
be easy to open again should the
need arise.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
你踹開通風口時
把門閂弄壞了。以後
需要的話，應該很容易
再打開。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou think you see something moving\nat the other end of the corridor.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n你覺得看到走廊\n另一頭有東西在動。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nA few meters down the corridor\nyou see an intersection.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n沿著走廊走幾公尺，\n你看到一個岔路口。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The floor's only noticeable feature is
a strange-looking platform in the center
of the room.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這層樓唯一顯眼的東西，
就是房間中央那座
外形古怪的平台。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThis support obviously helps hold\nthe ceiling up.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n這根支柱顯然是用來\n撐住天花板的。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You step onto the platform, but this time
nothing happens.  Apparently the Cosmic
Gender Bender has been shut down pending
repairs to the medical complex.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你踏上平台，但這次
什麼事也沒發生。看來
錯體機已經關閉，
等待醫療區維修。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You now know where the 'decorator from hell' lives.
Trashy wall hangings assault you with violent
pastel colors.  A thick layer of dust covers everything,
leading you to believe that the place has been
abandoned for a long time.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你終於知道『地獄室內
設計師』住在哪了。
俗氣的壁飾用刺眼的
粉彩色朝你襲來。厚厚
一層灰塵蓋滿全場，
看來這裡已經荒廢
很久了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The carpet undulates nauseously before
your gaze.  From the layer of dust you
conclude that no one has walked on it
in decades.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這片地毯的花紋看得你
直反胃，彷彿在起伏。
從那層灰塵判斷，
幾十年沒人踩過它了。

column2: [title29][sentence]\nThis little hallway leads to the\nbuilding entrance.
column3: [title29][sentence]\n這條小走廊通往\n建築物的入口。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nA silly little lamp adorns one of the\ntables.  The rest are bare.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
其中一張桌上擺著
一盞蠢兮兮的小燈，
其餘桌子都是空的。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Cheap, flat, uncomfortable cushions beckon
uninvitingly from the dusty molded plastic chairs.
You have no urge to sit on any of them.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
積滿灰塵的塑膠模製椅上，
擺著廉價、扁塌、
坐起來不舒服的坐墊，
毫無吸引力。你完全
沒興趣坐上去。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
Argh!  How could someone actually put these
things on his wall?!  A wave of nausea passes
through you.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
啊啊！怎麼會有人
把這種東西掛上牆？！
一陣噁心感湧上心頭。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Well, it isn't exactly a fireplace.  It's more like
an 'ugly little corner with blinking lights in it'.  Being
the type of person who couldn't even own a
spacecraft without a genuine wood-burning
fireplace you cringe at the plastic logs and
electric lights.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
嗯，這不算真的壁爐，
比較像是『裝了閃燈的
醜陋小角落』。你是那種
連太空船都非得配一座
真材實料柴火壁爐不可的人，
看到這些塑膠木柴
和電燈，你渾身不自在。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Several pictures hang between various pieces of junk
on the walls here.  Someone probably considers
these art.  You consider them terrarium lining
material.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
牆上在各種雜物之間
掛著幾幅畫。大概有人
把這當藝術品。你倒覺得
拿來鋪飼養箱底層
還比較實用。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The appeal of the silly lamps in this room
escapes you.  You imagine them serving
better as ballast.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這房間裡那些蠢燈
哪裡吸引人，你完全
看不出來。你覺得拿去
當壓艙物還比較有用。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Ah yes, the obligatory theatrical masks.
These could probably be used as targets
at a skeet shoot.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
啊，果然少不了這種
裝飾用戲劇面具。
拿去玩飛靶射擊
說不定還挺適合。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nConsidering the rest of the decor, you are\nnot at all surprised to find one of these here.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
看看這裡其他的裝潢，
會找到這種東西，
你一點都不意外。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This doorway leads to the bedroom.
The same psychopath who decorated the
room must be responsible for this.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這道門通往臥室。
八成也是那個裝潢
這房間的神經病搞的。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This looks like a standard wall safe.
A small dial and a handle feature
prominently on the door of the safe.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這看起來是標準的
壁式保險箱。門上
顯眼地裝著一個小轉盤
和一根把手。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The safe door is now hanging open.  A
few balance sheets from a company called
"Buckluster Video" are the only remaining
contents.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
保險箱門正開著。
裡面只剩幾張
『晦暗影業』的
資產負債表。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The safe door is now hanging open.  A
small key gleams atop a pile of balance
sheets from a company named "Buckluster
Video."
column3:
[title27][sentence]
保險箱門正開著。
一把小鑰匙在一疊
『晦暗影業』資產
負債表上閃著光。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThis is a combination safe.  A\nkey isn't going to get you anywhere.
column3: [title24][sentence]\n這是密碼鎖保險箱。\n光靠鑰匙可打不開。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Wishing for a stethoscope, you spin
the dial a few times.  After a few
attempts you realize that the odds
of success are slim.  You need
to find out what the combination is.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你多希望手邊有支
聽診器，轉了幾次轉盤。
試了幾次後你發現
成功機率微乎其微。
你得先查出密碼
才行。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe fireplace is fake.  There are no flames\nin it at all.  Why put the [noun1] in it?"
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這座壁爐是假的，
裡面完全沒有真的
火焰。幹嘛把[noun1]
放進去？」

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The laser beam has carved a hole in the
floor, and a corresponding hole in the
ceiling.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
雷射光束在地板上
鑿出一個洞，天花板
對應位置也有一個洞。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe laser beam is extremely dangerous.\nYou had better be careful where you walk.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這道雷射光束
極度危險。你走路
最好看清楚點。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou skillfully and CAREFULLY place the\n[noun1] in the laser beam . . . .
column3:
[title21][sentence]
你熟練又『小心翼翼』地
把[noun1]放進雷射
光束之中……

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe flower boxes contain dust-covered plastic flowers,\nand little else of interest.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
花箱裡裝著積滿灰塵
的塑膠花，沒什麼
其他值得看的東西。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
If you set off a bomb in this enclosed
space, you would end up splattered
all over the walls.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
要是在這密閉空間
引爆炸彈，你會被炸得
滿牆都是。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Unfortunately, you cannot find a place
to set the time bomb that is close
enough to the safe to yield a high probability
of success.  Surely there is a more
elegant way to crack the safe.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
可惜你找不到一個
離保險箱夠近、能提高
成功率的地方來放
定時炸彈。開這保險箱
一定還有更高明的
辦法。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Your trick with the laser has blown a
gaping hole in the safe.  You should be
able to reach through and open it now.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你用雷射玩的這招，
把保險箱炸出了一個
大洞。現在你應該伸手
進去就能把它打開了。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nIn the charred remains of the safe, you\nsee a slightly scorched door key.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
在燒焦的保險箱殘骸中，
你看到一把略微
燒黑的門鑰匙。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
In the charred remains of the safe, you
see nothing except a few crisped balance
sheets for a company called "Buckluster
Video."
column3:
[title32][sentence]
在燒焦的保險箱殘骸中，
除了幾張烤得酥脆的
『晦暗影業』資產
負債表之外，什麼
都沒有。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This enormous strip connects two of the city's
upper sections.  From the wear on the surface
you assume it was built for wheeled traffic.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這條巨大的路面
連接城市上層的
兩個區域。從表面的
磨損痕跡判斷，
應該是給輪式車輛
使用的。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The ropes hanging down from the
armatures are suspending a boat above
a restaurant on the lower level.  They are
connected to a pair of small winches.  You
assume the control box on one of the
armatures must control the winches.  The
winches look like they have rusted away.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
從支架垂下的繩索，
吊著一艘船，懸在下層
一家餐廳上方。繩索
連著一對小型絞盤。
你猜其中一個支架上的
控制箱，應該是用來
操控絞盤的。這些絞盤
看起來已經鏽壞了。
